evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented distinction enacts market-pricing proportionality — intelligence valued by acquisition modality (own vs. rent), a cost-benefit framing of what you keep versus what you borrow.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' performs market-pricing: proportionality between commodity substrate and retained asset, valuing one over the other by what is worth holding.
